faqs.question: What majors and programs does the Faculty of Engineering and Computer Science offer?
faqs.answer: Undergraduate (BS): Computer & Communications Engineering (CCE), CCE with a Biomedical Engineering emphasis, Mechatronics Engineering, Computer Science, and Information & Communications Technology (ICT). Graduate (MS): Computer & Communications Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Computer Science, and ICT.
